title.value: M ASAKHA NEWS: NEWS TOPIC CLASSIFICATION FOR A FRICAN LANGUAGES
title.justification: This title captures the essence of the paper which is about building a news topic classification system for African languages.
title.quote: In this paper, we develop MasakhaNEWS — a new benchmark dataset for news topic classification covering 16 languages widely spoken in Africa.

extractions.description: This scientific paper addresses the challenge of under-representation of African languages in NLP research. It introduces MasakhaNEWS, a dataset designed for news topic classification across 16 African languages. The paper evaluates different machine learning models, including fine-tuning with large language models and few-shot learning approaches, to improve news classification in low-resource African languages.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper is focused on NLP for African languages and does not directly address climate or ecologically-related sustainable development.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: African languages are severely under-represented in NLP research due to lack of datasets covering several NLP tasks.

primary_category.justification: The paper does not focus on climate or ecological sustainability topics, thus it is not applicable to any of the listed climate-related categories.
primary_category.quote: In this paper, we address two problems of lack of evaluation datasets, and lack of extensive evaluation of LLMs for African languages.

secondary_categories.justification: The topics covered do not relate to secondary climate or ecological sustainability themes.
secondary_categories.quote: The primary focus of the paper is on developing NLP resources for African languages.

primary_sub_category.justification: No sub-category related to climate or sustainable development applies to this paper's content on NLP and language datasets.
primary_sub_category.quote: We create MasakhaNEWS — a large-scale news topic classification dataset covering 16 typologically-diverse languages widely spoken in Africa.

secondary_sub_categories.justification: The paper does not offer content that fits into secondary sustainable development-related sub-categories.
secondary_sub_categories.quote: This work focuses on news topic classification for African languages, which is not related to ecological issues.

applications.value: Facilitating NLP advancements for African languages
applications.justification: This is a specific application related to increasing the representation of African languages in NLP, though not linked to sustainability.
applications.quote: We hope that MasakhaNEWS encourages the NLP community to benchmark and evaluate LLMs on more low-resource languages.

new_primary_category.justification: The focus of the paper remains on NLP and does not introduce new climate-related categories.
new_primary_category.quote: The focus is on news topic classification benchmarks for African languages.

new_primary_sub_category.justification: The paper centers on a language resource development which doesn't align with new or existing sustainability sub-categories.
new_primary_sub_category.quote: This research develops a dataset for news classification in African languages, unrelated to climate issues.
